lines.say: a peptide from their own DNA that protects cells (lab studies; never tested in people)
protected nerve cells from amyloid-beta, the Alzheimer's protein (cell studies)
less heart damage after an induced heart attack (mouse studies)
its analog HNG lowered visceral fat but didn't extend lifespan (mouse study)
unclear effects on tumor growth and spread; the studies are inconclusive
smaller bodies and fewer offspring in worms and mice with more humanin (animal studies)

ask: Is there any human evidence that taking humanin is safe or helpful?
